purpose: Install or adapt the Project Frankenstein/EntityOS research interface without scanning the whole repository or inventing host capabilities.

classifications.NATIVE: Host has an actual supported integration path and the declared lifecycle/state/effect receipts were observed from that path.
classifications.ADAPTED: Useful filesystem/project/tool integration is verified, but one or more required lifecycle features are supplied by an adapter rather than native host semantics.
classifications.DEGRADED: Context/instructions can be used but durable lifecycle/state/effect verification is incomplete or unavailable.
classifications.BLOCKED: The host cannot access the required project material or cannot safely establish the minimum integration path.

anti_fake_success: Presence of a CLI binary is not a successful install.
Presence of CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md is not proof the host loaded it.
A generated receipt is not proof a native hook fired unless the host invoked it through the declared hook path.
A write request is not proof the file/state exists after reopen.
A tool request is not proof the external effect occurred.
Do not classify NATIVE from documentation alone.
current_authority_warning: At Trigger-3 re-entry, supervisor 9.13 has external provider routes HARD_OFF and Together forbidden. Installer/adapters must not probe provider credentials or network routes merely to discover capabilities.
